description: This file implements the core logic for resetting the state of a Git repository, including updating references (like HEAD and ORIG_HEAD), performing hard resets, checkout operations, and unpacking trees to reflect the reset. It contains functions such as reset_head and update_refs, which handle various resetting scenarios.

methods.name: int update_refs(const struct reset_head_opts * opts,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * head)
methods.description: Updates the repository references such as HEAD and ORIG_HEAD, handles reflog messages, detachment, and hook execution based on provided options.

methods.name: int reset_head(struct repository * r,const struct reset_head_opts * opts)
methods.description: Performs a reset operation on the repository, including hard resets, checkout, updating references, and unpacking trees to restore or move the repository to a specific state.
